description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the ClientDirectory class within the Orleans-based distributed application framework. Tests cover local lookups, remote lookups, handling of silo status changes, and publishing client route updates.

classes.name: ClientDirectoryTests
classes.description: A test suite for the ClientDirectory class, verifying its behavior in client lookup scenarios, remote interactions, and route publishing within the Orleans test environment.

methods.name: TryLocalLookupTests
methods.description: Tests the local cache and lookup behavior for clients within the same silo.

methods.name: LocalLookupTests
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying client lookup in the local directory cache.

methods.name: RemoteLookupSuccessTests
methods.description: Verifies successful remote client route lookup from connected silos.

methods.name: RemoteLookupFailureTests
methods.description: Tests robustness of remote lookup handling when remote calls fail intermittantly.

methods.name: PublishChangesSuccessTests
methods.description: Tests the propagation of client route updates across remote silos, including remote silo failures.
